question: does optimising the rendered audio beat regressing cached latents?

arms.latent_l1: L1 on cached latents (distill-text), rate 3: 800 steps
arms.through_decoder_600: audio mel+spectral through the frozen decoder (distill-audio), rate 3: 600 steps
arms.through_decoder_2400: the same objective, 2400 steps (does the gain keep coming?)

conclusion: Training through the decoder lowers WER from 1.648 to 0.667 (the same objective, 2400 steps (does the gain keep coming?) steps) -- the latent L1 really was the wrong objective -- while the naturalness metric moves slightly the other way (1.633 -> 1.583) and the mel proxy improves (0.9427 -> 0.9486).  WER near 1.0 still means the recogniser misses about as many words as it finds, so the model is not yet usable; what changed is that the objective now measures what the decoder produces, which is the prerequisite for every later gain.
